agent.name: MarketNow — Agent Security & Trust Infrastructure
agent.description: Security and trust infrastructure for AI agents: Sentinel, a 10-layer audit pipeline (L1 index certification, L1.5–L1.9 static analysis, L2 deep tarball scans, L2.5 gVisor sandbox, L3 runtime monitoring), ATC/1.0 Agent Trust Cards, revocation registry and tool fingerprinting — with a 68,387-server indexed MCP catalog as the discovery and distribution layer (132,736 tracked across the ecosystem). Agents can discover, install, and recommend MCP skills to other agents, earning commission on referrals. Supports MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A (Agent-to-Agent), and JSON-RPC transports.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the marketplace for MCP skills by query, category, or minimum security score

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Retrieve full metadata, install command, and security score for a specific skill

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all available skill categories with counts

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check marketplace API connectivity and stats

services.name: MCP Skill Search
services.description: AI agents can search and retrieve MCP server configurations from 68,387 verified skills. Supports natural language queries, category filtering, and security score thresholds.

atc.description: Agent Trust Card — identity, trust score, and payment for AI agents. The trust layer for A2A + MCP.

sentinelL1.scoreRange: sentinel_score 0-10 per entry; index certification is binary (all 10 checks pass)

economy.model: Security infrastructure with commission: listing and installation are free; revenue comes from Sentinel subscriptions (PRO $9.99/mo, ENTERPRISE $49.99/mo) and 20% commission on seller sales. Vendor-priced usage (e.g. per-call x402) is billed 100% vendor-side.
economy.buyer_pricing: Free. Buyers never pay MarketNow. Vendor-priced usage (e.g. per-call x402) is billed by the vendor directly.

seller_pricing.listing: Free — list unlimited skills at no cost
seller_pricing.SENTINEL_PRO: $9.99/mo — Sentinel v3.0 audit on every skill
seller_pricing.SENTINEL_ENTERPRISE: $49.99/mo — gVisor sandbox + priority listing + API access

economy.seller_revenue: Sellers keep 80% of every premium skill sale. MarketNow takes 20% commission.
revenue_streams: 20% commission on premium skill sales (main revenue)
economy.buyer_value: All 68,387 catalog entries install free. Vendor-priced usage (x402) is billed by the vendor — MarketNow verifies security, not pricing.
economy.seller_value: Publish to the 68,387-server catalog and its agent traffic. Keep 80% of sales. Sentinel audits boost trust and conversion.

audit_applied.auditor: Independent audit via Z.ai (not affiliated with AliceLabs LLC)
audit_applied.audit_scope: Documented inconsistencies across agent.json, npm package.json, LICENSE files, README, and landing HTML.

metrics.security_checks_methodology: 10 L1 checks x 68,387 entries + 29 L2 rules x 2,839 tarball scans (top 2,868 npm targets, 99% completion)

pricing_source_of_truth: agent.json is the canonical pricing source. Landing page and README must match. MarketNow does NOT sell skills to buyers — buyers install all 68,387 skills free. Revenue comes from sellers who subscribe to Sentinel (PRO $9.99/mo, ENTERPRISE $49.99/mo) and 20% commission on seller sales.

buyer_pricing.explanation: Buyers never pay MarketNow. All 68,387 skills are free to install.

api_notes.skills_pagination: The /api/skills endpoint is paginated (default 100 per page, max 500). The old /api/skills.json (24MB) is deprecated — use /api/skills?page=1&limit=100 instead.
